opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one and £28,000 per year in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK, hold a doctorate, and meet residency and employment criteria.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to undertake a significant piece of publishable research; the Trust funds the Fellow’s salary (up to £56k year 1, £28k years 2‑3) and up to £6k per year for research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities, other UK higher‑education institutions, and on a trial basis UK‑based independent research institutes/organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative research projects up to five years, covering staff costs, consumables and other research expenses.
discipline_tags: All disciplines (excluding medical, policy‑driven, commercial‑application and database‑focused research)

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or specialist arts institutions) who will coordinate the visit of an eminent overseas professor.
opportunities.summary: Funding to bring an eminent senior professor from overseas to the UK for 3–12 months, enhancing skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent) who have at least two years post‑PhD experience and have not previously led a research team.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support talented early‑career scholars to build a research team and pursue distinctive research problems over 4–5 years.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students under 18 years of age studying fine and performing arts at specialist arts institutions or registered charities.
opportunities.summary: Scholarships to support undergraduate students in the fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate and postgraduate students in fine and performing arts at specialist arts institutions or registered charities.
opportunities.summary: Scholarships and bursaries to support students in the fine and performing arts at undergraduate and postgraduate levels.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired senior researchers who wish to complete a research project and prepare results for publication.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for senior researchers to finish a research project and disseminate findings.
